column1: # Recipe share code test vectors. Same file in Recipe Lab (camera), Recipe Lab Studio and recipelab.io.
# Version 1: version, family, the family values, name. Version 2: the same, then the picture profile, then the name;
# only a recipe with a picture profile is written in it, so a recipe without one keeps its version 1 code.
# valid (version 1): code, name, style, saturation, contrast, sharpness, white-balance, amber-blue, green-magenta, exposure-thirds, dro, effect, effect-option (- for none)
# profile (version 2): valid's columns, then gamma, color-mode, black-level, black-gamma, black-gamma-range, knee, knee-slope, color-saturation, color-phase, s-curve
